head: Watch for coconut
and palm oil
name: Dr. Neal Barnard
end_cta: Find Dr. Neal Barnard on|Vegans Explore

captions.text: There's no cholesterol in a plant product, or virtually none.
The cholesterol is in animal products,
and when you stop eating animal products, you stop eating cholesterol.
But a couple of exceptions: coconut oil and palm oil, also palm kernel oil.
These are high in saturated fat, and they stimulate cholesterol formation.
Look at a jar of peanut butter.
It's not just ground up peanuts, which is what it should be. They added palm oil to it.
Look for the brands that don't have palm oil and coconut oil,
and if you avoid those things, your cholesterol level's likely to fall further.
